items.question: What is the monthly fee on a premium account?
items.answer: Premium accounts cost $15 per month, but the fee is waived when your average daily balance is above $10,000.

items.question: How long do I have to dispute a charge?
items.answer: You must file the dispute within 60 days of the date the transaction posted.

items.question: Does the daily limit apply when I move money between my own accounts?
items.answer: No. Transfers between two accounts owned by the same customer are exempt from the daily limit.

items.question: What does premium overdraft allow?
items.answer: Premium holders can spend past zero up to their set overdraft cap and won't be turned down.

items.question: Do savings accounts compound interest during the month?
items.answer: No, interest is simple and is not compounded within the period.

items.question: What extra step does a premium application need?
items.answer: Premium applications need an income check on top of the identity verification.

items.question: How many withdrawals can a savings account make?
What happens to a frozen account?
items.answer: Outbound transfers are blocked until an authorized reviewer lifts the freeze.

items.question: What is the monthly fee on a premium account?
items.answer: Premium accounts cost $25 per month, waived above $10,000.

items.question: How long do I have to dispute a charge?
items.answer: You have 90 days to dispute a transaction.

items.question: Does the daily limit apply when I move money between my own accounts?
items.answer: Yes, transfers between your own accounts count toward the daily limit like any other transfer.

items.question: What does premium overdraft allow?
items.answer: Premium accounts can go negative up to $5,000 and are charged a $30 overdraft fee each time.

items.question: Do savings accounts compound interest during the month?
Which accounts need income verification?
items.answer: Savings accounts require the same income verification as premium accounts.

items.question: What happens to a frozen account?
items.answer: A frozen account can still make outbound transfers under $500.

items.question: How are disputes between my own accounts handled?
items.answer: Disputes between a customer's own accounts are escalated to the fraud review team.
